name: Regulation of kidney size and metanephric development
rationale: All members regulate kidney/metanephros development or size, unlike confusables centred on renal cell proliferation, tubule epithelial differentiation or nephric duct/ureter formation.

core: Inherited renal amino acid transporter defects
name: Iminoglycinuria from proline and glycine transporter defects
rationale: All three members are SLC6A20/SLC36A2 defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, distinguishing them from Hartnup, cystinuria, hexose and urate transporter disorders in the confusables.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation, coronavirus modulation
name: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signaling regulation and coronavirus modulation
rationale: Members cover cytosolic RNA sensing by RIG-I/MDA5 with downstream TRAF3/TRAF6-IRF/NF-kB activation and its regulation; SARS-CoV modulation and bidirectional RIG-I regulation set it apart from confusables emphasising IRF3/IRF7 interferon induction and RSV evasion.

core: Nucleoside and nucleobase transport with adenine nucleotide interconversion
name: Nucleoside transport and adenine nucleotide interconversion, incl. mitochondrial ADP/ATP
rationale: Members concern moving nucleosides, nucleobases, nucleoside-analog drugs and ADP/ATP across membranes plus adenosine/ADP interconversion; mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport and nucleoside transporters distinguish it from the broader nucleotide synthesis/salvage confusables.

name: MHC class II antigen presentation, including myeloid co-expression modules
rationale: All members describe exogenous peptide presentation on MHC class II or co-expression modules of it; the antigen-presentation and monocyte expression modules distinguish it from confusables that instead add regulation of presentation or lipid/TLR7 presentation.

name: RUNX1 transcriptional regulation of haematopoietic lineage genes
rationale: Members are RUNX-factor control of myeloid, megakaryocyte, B cell receptor and interleukin genes plus RUNX1 regulation itself, whereas confusables add non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets (estrogen, WNT, keratinocyte) or megakaryocyte development alone.

qualifier: intestinal/renal hexose absorption and inherited deficiencies
name: Glycogen turnover and hexose absorption, including inherited deficiencies
rationale: Members span glycogen synthesis/breakdown and its storage diseases together with dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transport defects; this pairing separates it from glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, urate and galactose-catabolism confusables.

qualifier: telomerase RNA trafficking to Cajal bodies
name: Telomere maintenance and telomerase RNA trafficking to Cajal bodies
rationale: Members cover telomere replication, telomerase extension, recombination-based maintenance, capping and associated DNA-structure handling; Cajal body localization of telomerase RNA/scaRNA and RNA folding distinguish it from the general DNA repair confusables.

core: Innate inflammatory cytokine control by TLR and inflammasome sensing
qualifier: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing and NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasomes
name: TLR2/4 LPS sensing and NLRP3 inflammasome cytokine control
rationale: Members regulate LPS/lipopeptide detection via TLR2/4 and MyD88/IRAK4 plus NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasome IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine output, distinguishing it from pyroptosis/caspase-4/5, TRIF-dependent and myeloid-signature confusables.

core: Fc receptor regulation of immune activation
qualifier: inhibitory Fc and SIRP receptor signaling
name: Fc and SIRP receptor inhibitory tuning of immune activation
rationale: Members concern Fc receptor signaling balance and SIRP-family interactions that restrain phagocytosis, neutrophil and B cell receptor activation, unlike confusables centred on Fc-gamma activation, ADCC and hypersensitivity or BCR signaling itself.

name: Fas/TRAIL caspase-8 apoptosis in T cell immunity
rationale: Members describe Fas/TRAIL-induced caspase-8 activation, c-FLIP and BID with T cell activation-induced death, thymocyte apoptosis and allograft/tumour responses, whereas confusables emphasise TNFR1, necroptosis and hepatocyte survival.

qualifier: monocyte-dominated, with monocyte activation and neutrophil modules
name: Monocyte-dominated leukocyte surface and expression signatures
rationale: Members are mostly monocyte, dendritic cell and neutrophil expression/surface signatures with a few lymphoid ones; monocyte activation and neutrophil modules separate it from confusables focused on DC differentiation, lipid antigen presentation or lymphocyte surface signatures.

core: Wnt signaling at ligand and receptor level
qualifier: ligand secretion and non-canonical calcium signaling
name: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/calcium signaling
rationale: Members cover PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis/secretion, Frizzled/ROR2 regulation and Wnt/Ca2+ signaling, distinguishing it from confusables built on beta-catenin destruction complex and TCF-dependent transcription or Hedgehog signaling.

name: Protein stability control by ubiquitin-proteasome and TRiC chaperonin folding
rationale: Members regulate protein stabilization versus ubiquitin-proteasome degradation together with TRiC/CCT-assisted folding, the chaperonin part distinguishing it from confusables on stress granules, deubiquitinases or proteasome inhibition.

name: mRNA and snRNA nuclear export with snRNP assembly
rationale: Members describe nuclear pore export of mature mRNAs and snRNAs plus snRNP maturation (cap hypermethylation), separating it from 3'-end processing, spliceosome and ribosome/tRNA export confusables.

name: TRP channel-mediated nociception and thermosensation
rationale: Members concern detection of thermal, mechanical, acid and chemical stimuli in pain and thermoception through TRP channels, whereas confusables rely on two-pore K+ channels, itch or fever.

name: Gluconeogenesis, glucose-6-phosphate handling and fructose catabolism
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis from alanine/oxaloacetate, glucose-6-phosphate transport/hydrolysis, glucokinase control and fructose breakdown disorders, distinguishing it from glycerol, glycolysis and glycogen-synthesis confusables.

name: Sulfur amino acid catabolism, sulfide oxidation and histidine breakdown
rationale: Members centre on transsulfuration, cysteine/H2S catabolism and sulfide-to-sulfate oxidation (with molybdenum cofactor), while histidine catabolism distinguishes it from confusables adding vitamin B6, selenium or phenylalanine metabolism.

core: Golgi/ER glycosylation of signaling proteins and proteoglycans
qualifier: Notch/TSR O-fucose and O-glucose glycosylation with heparan sulfate synthesis
name: Notch/TSR O-glycosylation and heparan sulfate proteoglycan synthesis
rationale: Members concern O-fucosylation/O-glucosylation of Notch and TSR proteins and EXT-dependent heparan sulfate/heparin synthesis, distinguishing it from chondroitin/dermatan sulfate, somitogenesis and Wnt-secretion confusables.

core: Extracellular matrix oxidative maturation and turnover
name: Ascorbate-linked matrix cross-linking and hyaluronan turnover
rationale: Members link ascorbate/dehydroascorbate transport and oxidative protein modification to collagen cross-linking, basement membrane assembly and hyaluronan degradation, the last two separating it from elastic-fibre, collagen-synthesis and vitamin C response confusables.

name: Misfolded protein quality control via ERAD and organelle-selective autophagy
rationale: Members handle misfolded proteins through ubiquitination, ERAD and selective autophagy of ER, peroxisomes, nucleus and late endosomes, distinguishing it from aggrephagy/chaperone-mediated autophagy and proteasome-regulation confusables.

name: MHC class II antigen presentation and its regulation
rationale: All members are MHC class II peptide presentation or its (including negative) regulation; the regulatory members distinguish it from the closest confusable, while others involve MHC class I cross-presentation or cell-surface signatures.

qualifier: mevalonate isoprenoid start through Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell branches
name: Mevalonate-to-cholesterol biosynthesis, Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell branches
rationale: Members trace isoprenoid precursor synthesis via mevalonate to lanosterol and both cholesterol branches, distinguishing it from fatty acid elongation, bile acid synthesis and dolichol confusables.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and coenzyme A supply
name: TCA cycle and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes with coenzyme A supply
rationale: Members cover PDH/OGDH/OADH complexes, their lipoylation and DLD, TCA cycle intermediates and CoA biosynthesis, separating it from confusables on Fe-S assembly/ATP synthesis or glycine/lysine catabolism.

name: Negative regulation of VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: All members inhibit VEGF production/signaling and endothelial proliferation, migration and tube formation, distinguishing it from confusables dominated by positive angiogenic regulation.
